intro:
This document is generated. Do not edit it by hand. To change it, edit the CSV files in ui_blueprint/ (pairs.csv, behavior.csv, help.csv) or the HTML and the translations, then run build_ui_help_md.mjs.

The window has four areas, and each has its own tab on the settings page. The first-run setup at startup is a part-only area: it is not one of the four, and it has no settings tab and no eye button.

AreaSettings tabCovers
HeaderHeaderTitle bar, menus, and the theme, language and zoom controls
Editor and toolbarEditorEditing, the toolbar, document tabs, the status bar and the LLM chat
Suggestion sidebarSidebarKnowledge search and suggestions, the guideline and the knowledge slots
Bottom bar and systemSystemThe log, the pipeline state, the save result and the update notice
First-run setup—The three steps at startup. There is no settings tab and no eye button

A setting and a part of the window relate in one of three ways.

RelationMeaning
LinkedThe window has a control for the same value; changing either one updates the other
ReflectedThe window has no control for it, but the setting changes how the window looks or behaves
Settings onlyThe window has no matching part

Each part of the window can be shown or hidden with its eye button under "Parts of the window" on the System tab. Essential parts cannot be hidden.

Header.title: Header
Header.html:
Settings tab: "Header". Title bar, menus, and the theme, language and zoom controls.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Logo and app versionhdr:logoThe app logo and version. Click it to open the About dialog.Yes
Menu barhdr:menu-barThe area that holds the File, Edit, View, Window and Help menus and the About button. Each menu can also be hidden on its own.Yes (with a notice)
File menuhdr:menu-fileDocument and workspace commands: New, Open, Open Workspace, Save, Save As, Save All, Close Tab, Settings and Exit.Save location (Linked)Yes
Edit menuhdr:menu-editUndo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All.Yes
View menuhdr:menu-viewShow or hide the sidebar and the system log, zoom in, zoom out and reset, and switch the theme and the language.Yes
Window menuhdr:menu-windowMinimize, maximize (restore) and close the window.Yes
Help menuhdr:menu-helpReopen the first-run setup, and Documentation (opens the repository page in your browser).Yes
Overflow menu (»)hdr:menu-overflowThe » button that holds the menus that do not fit when the window is narrow. Press it to open the hidden menus as a list. It does not appear when everything fits.Yes
Appearance mode button (header)hdr:color-modeThe appearance mode switch: Light, System (follows the OS) or Dark. The theme stays and shows its light or dark face.Appearance (Linked)Yes
Theme menu (header)hdr:theme-selectThe color theme menu. Every theme has a light and a dark face; the appearance mode picks which one is shown.Appearance (Linked)Yes
Zoom display (header)hdr:zoom-selectShows the zoom level of the whole window (100% is standard). The mouse wheel zooms in and out, and a click returns to 100%.UI Scaling (Zoom) (Linked)Yes
Settings button (header gear)hdr:settings-btnThe gear button that opens the Settings page. This button cannot be hidden.No (essential)
Header minimize buttonhdr:minimizeThe button that minimizes or expands the header.Yes

How it behaves

Help menu (hdr:menu-help)

WhenThen
Documentation is chosenOpens the in-app Help page: the guide to the window and the settings (four areas and the first-run setup) as a searchable document. The repository page is a button inside it

Zoom display (header) (hdr:zoom-select)

WhenThen
Mouse wheel upZooms in one step (up to a limit)
Mouse wheel downZooms out one step (down to a limit)
Click (when not at 100%)Resets to 100%
HoverShows a magnifier with bold up (zoom in) and down (zoom out) arrows and the label Zoom, to say the mouse wheel works

Settings button (header gear) (hdr:settings-btn)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the settings page (the Header tab by default). It is essential and cannot be hidden

Settings

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
AppearanceLight, dark, or follow the system. The theme shows its light or dark face.LinkedAppearance mode button (header)
LanguageSwitch application locale.LinkedLanguage
UI Scaling (Zoom)Adjust the overall size of the application UI.LinkedZoom display (header)
Save locationFolder for new documents and the settings file (.settings.json).LinkedFile menu

What stops working when hidden

Hiding these parts shows a notice. The eye button brings them back.

PartWhen hidden
Menu barThe menu bar is hidden. The File, Edit, View, Window and Help menus are not shown.

Editor.title: Editor and toolbar
Editor.html:
Settings tab: "Editor". Editing, the toolbar, document tabs, the status bar and the LLM chat.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Editor toolbaredt:toolbarThe bar above the editor. It holds the Save button, the background tone, the font and its size, the LLM button and the settings gear. Hiding the bar hides all of them.Yes
Save buttonedt:saveThe Save button. The left part saves at once (while AutoSave waits for a location, it asks for one). The arrow opens a menu with the AutoSave switch, Save As and Save All. The lamp shows the AutoSave state (green = saving, orange = waiting for a location, grey = off). Hiding this part hides the button and the arrow together.Autosave (Linked), Autosave (Reflected)Yes (with a notice)
Background tone selectoredt:bg-toneChooses the background tone of the editor.Font Family (Linked)Yes
Font menu (toolbar)edt:font-familyChooses the editor font.Font Family (Linked)Yes
Text size menu (toolbar)edt:font-sizeChooses the editor text size.Font Family (Linked)Yes
Editor AI buttonedt:ai-toggleSwitches the editor's LLM assistant on or off. When it is off, a click turns it on and opens the chat dock below. When no model is set, a click opens Settings.LLM (cloud AI) (Linked)Yes
Editor settings gearedt:quick-settingsThe gear button that opens the editor preferences.Yes
Document tabsedt:tab-barThe tabs of the open documents. Right-click a tab to duplicate it; the + button opens a new document. A tab with unsaved changes always asks before it closes.Yes (with a notice)
Markdown preview buttonedt:markdown-previewThe button that shows or hides the rendered Markdown preview. For a Text document it is disabled and shows the reason beside it.Yes
Editor status baredt:status-barThe strip under the editor: character count, line count, encoding, the document format (Markdown and Text are shown side by side and either can be chosen; the chosen format sets the default file name and extension of a manual save) and the Markdown preview button.Yes
Document format switchedt:document-formatShows the format of the open document (Markdown or Text) and switches it. Point at it to list both choices; the one you choose sets the file name and extension when you save.Format of new documents (Linked)Yes
LLM chat dockedt:llm-dockThe chat panel below the editor, for asking an LLM about your text or having it rewritten. It has the provider choice and the API key field, and buttons to clear the history, collapse and close it.LLM (chat and rewriting) (Linked), Gemini Model (Reflected), OpenAI API Key (Reflected), Anthropic API Key (Reflected)Yes
Chat dock: API key buttonedt:llm-key-configOpens the API key settings of the chat dock, where you set the LLM API key.Google Gemini API Key (Linked), OpenAI API Key (Linked), Anthropic API Key (Linked)Yes
Chat dock: clear history buttonedt:llm-clear-chatClears the whole conversation in the chat dock at once. No confirmation is asked. It cannot be pressed while the LLM is off or no API key is set.Yes
Chat dock: collapse buttonedt:llm-collapseThe button that minimizes or expands the chat dock.Yes
Chat dock: close buttonedt:llm-closeThe button that closes the chat dock. A confirmation appears first.Yes

How it behaves

Save button (edt:save)

WhenThen
Lamp is greenAutoSave is on and the document has a file
Lamp is orangeAutoSave is on but the document has no file yet; typing is kept as a draft only
Lamp is greyAutoSave is off (the user turned it off)

Editor AI button (edt:ai-toggle)

WhenThen
The model is not set up (no key)Asks to confirm, then opens the LLM card on the Editor tab of the settings
LLM is offTurns LLM on and opens the chat dock. Embedding is not changed. Calls to Gemini and the like become possible
LLM is onTurns LLM off and closes the chat dock. While off, chat, Ctrl+K, the right-click LLM chat and Gemini suggestions are unavailable. Embedding is not changed
When switchedShows the same sentence in a toast and in the log (for example [AI] LLM: ON → OFF)

Editor settings gear (edt:quick-settings)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the Editor tab of the settings page

Markdown preview button (edt:markdown-preview)

WhenThen
Document is MarkdownThe button can be pressed. It switches the body to the rendered view and the button reads Edit
Document is TextThe button stays visible but disabled, with the reason beside it. An open preview closes and returns to the editor

Document format switch (edt:document-format)

WhenThen
HoverShows both formats (Markdown and Text) side by side and either can be chosen. The chosen format sets the default file name and extension in the manual save dialog (it can still be changed there)

LLM chat dock (edt:llm-dock)

WhenThen
LLM is offCloses the chat dock and disables input, send and clear
Drag the top borderChanges the dock height. Double-click resets it. The height is remembered (can be turned off in the settings)
A question about the app (for example what Embedding is or whether the font can be changed)Puts the matching cards of the guide in front of the question and has the LLM answer within them. What the guide does not cover is answered with I do not know and a pointer to Settings or the Guide button. Other requests (such as rewriting a text) get nothing added

Chat dock: API key button (edt:llm-key-config)

WhenThen
A key is storedShows only the last 4 characters. Empty means unchanged, typing overwrites, the delete button removes it. The key stays in the main process and is never sent back to the window

Settings

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Font FamilySelect typeface for text rendering.LinkedFont menu (toolbar)
Word WrapToggle automatic text wrapping based on viewport width.ReflectedWord wrap of the Monaco editor
Format of new documentsSets the file extension of new documents (.md or .txt). Each document can still be switched in the status bar.LinkedDocument format switch
AutosaveSave the document automatically while you write.LinkedSave button
LLM (cloud AI)Turns the features that use a cloud AI such as Gemini on or off: chat, Ctrl+K and the LLM chat in the right-click menu. It does the same as the LLM button in the header, and turning it on also opens the chat dock. An API key must be set up first.LinkedEditor AI button

LLM (chat and rewriting)

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Same value as the provider choice in the chat dockUsed for the editor's bottom chat panel and direct rewriting/refinement conversations via right-click. Setting an API key will unlock the chat functionality.LinkedLLM chat dock
Google Gemini API KeyEnter your Google AI Studio API key. Stored securely only on your local machine.LinkedChat dock: API key button
Gemini ModelSet the API key, then click "Fetch Models" to get the latest list of Gemini models.ReflectedLLM chat dock
OpenAI API KeyEnter your OpenAI secret API key (sk-...). Stored securely only on your local machine.LinkedChat dock: API key button
Anthropic API KeyEnter your sk-ant-... secret key. Stored securely on your local device.LinkedChat dock: API key button

What stops working when hidden

Hiding these parts shows a notice. The eye button brings them back.

PartWhen hidden
Save buttonThe save button is hidden. The autosave LED and the save menu are not shown.
Document tabsThe document tabs are hidden. You cannot switch between open documents.

Sidebar.title: Suggestion sidebar
Sidebar.html:
Settings tab: "Sidebar". Knowledge search and suggestions, the guideline and the knowledge slots.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Suggestion sidebarsbr:sidebarThe suggestion sidebar. Drag its border to change the width.Yes (with a notice)
Embedding on/off buttonsbr:embedding-toggleSwitches the embedding assistant on or off. While it is on, semantically close suggestions appear in real time as you type.Embedding assistant (Linked), EMBEDDING CATALOG (Reflected)Yes
Sidebar settings gearsbr:quick-settingsThe gear button that opens the vector and knowledge settings.Yes
Guideline cardsbr:guideline-cardThe card for the active guideline (preset). Click to open or close it. You can insert a template, add files and unload the loaded guideline (this only detaches the file and deletes no data).Yes (with a notice)
Import dictionary buttonsbr:import-dictionaryLoads a goal profile (preset) from a file you choose. On success a notice shows the profile name.Suggestion Trigger Mode (Linked)Yes
Knowledge slots cardsbr:knowledge-cardThe card for the knowledge slots. Click to open or close it. Add files to add slots and detach a file with the X of its row. With two or more slots an Unload All button also appears (it only detaches files and deletes no data; it always asks to confirm). A badge shows how many slots are loaded. With LLM on and Embedding off Gemini suggestions appear in addition to the dictionary search.Yes (with a notice)
Add knowledge slot buttonsbr:add-slotThe button that adds a knowledge slot. Choosing a file adds one slot and opens the Knowledge card. A password-protected file asks for its password.Yes
Minimum score field (sidebar)sbr:score-filterThe minimum similarity a suggestion needs (50% to 99%, default 70%). Results below it are not shown.Suggestion Trigger Mode (Linked)Yes
Result limit menu (sidebar)sbr:limit-selectThe menu for the maximum number of suggestions.Suggestion Trigger Mode (Linked)Yes
Full metadata checkbox (sidebar)sbr:metadata-toggleWhen on, suggestion results show all metadata and attributes.Suggestion Trigger Mode (Linked)Yes
Metadata field checkboxes (sidebar)sbr:metadata-fieldsOne checkbox per field name found in the results (such as definition or facet). Only the ticked fields appear in the detail table of each card. With Full Metadata on, every field is shown and these checkboxes cannot be changed. Field names come from the result data, and the ticked state is saved.Yes
Editor options cardsbr:editor-options-cardThe card that lists every Monaco editor option. Click to expand or collapse. The search box filters by name or description. Changing an option updates the main editor at once and is saved with the settings. A changed option gets a coloured bar and a ↺ button that restores that option alone; the button in the card header restores them all. Options the settings page already owns (font, word wrap, line numbers and so on) are read-only here. See MONACO_OPTIONS.md for the full list.Word Wrap (Linked)Yes
Collapsed sidebar railsbr:railThe narrow column of icons that appears while the sidebar is collapsed. It has the expand, Guidelines and Knowledge buttons.Yes

How it behaves

Embedding on/off button (sbr:embedding-toggle)

WhenThen
Embedding is offTurns Embedding on. LLM is not changed
Embedding is onTurns Embedding off (the embedding model is not used). LLM is not changed
When switchedShows the same sentence in a toast and in the log (for example [AI] Embedding: ON → OFF)

Sidebar settings gear (sbr:quick-settings)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the Sidebar tab of the settings page

Knowledge slots card (sbr:knowledge-card)

WhenThen
When searchingDictionary search always runs. Vector search runs only while Embedding is on and Gemini suggestions only while LLM is on. With LLM on and Embedding off Gemini answers in place of the embedding model

Settings

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Embedding assistantReal-time semantic suggestions in the sidebar. It can be turned on or off apart from the LLM. When it is off, suggestions come from dictionary lookup (with help from Gemini while the LLM is on).LinkedEmbedding on/off button
AI Control CenterLive status for verification before configuring.
Suggestion Trigger ModeControl how vector suggestions are invoked (Selection Auto / Context Menu / Shortcut).LinkedMinimum score field (sidebar)

EMBEDDING CATALOG

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
The model name shown in the sidebarReflectedEmbedding on/off button

Cloud Vector Embedding (API Vectorizer)

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Guides to the LLM card on the Editor tabUse an external API for semantic search when you need higher accuracy. Local 384-dimension search stays the default. Set the API key in the Editor tab first.Settings only

What can each model do?

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
AI Capability ScopeEmbedding handles semantic search, while Generation Model handles text creation.

PartWhen hidden

System.title: Bottom bar and system
System.html:
Settings tab: "System". The log, the pipeline state, the save result and the update notice.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Log panel: clear buttonsys:log-clearClears all log entries from the log panel. A confirmation appears first.Log panel at startup (Linked)Yes
Log panel: copy buttonsys:log-copyThe button that copies all log entries to the clipboard.Log panel at startup (Linked)Yes
Log panel: save buttonsys:log-downloadThe button that saves all log entries to a text file.Log panel at startup (Linked)Yes
Bottom barsys:bottom-barThe bar at the bottom of the window: the log button, the pipeline state, the System settings gear, the update notice, the save result and the memory use.Yes (with a notice)
Log panelsys:log-consoleOpens or closes the log panel at the bottom. The panel shows the app's operation log. The setting Save logs chooses how the log is kept. By default nothing is saved and nothing is asked. Ask when exiting asks each time you quit. Always save keeps each start for 30 days. Saved logs can be opened from Saved logs in Settings.Log panel at startup (Reflected)Yes
Status info (characters, lines, encoding)sys:status-metaShows how much memory (RAM) the app uses.Yes
Pipeline status LEDssys:pipeline-meterSeven lamps for the startup state: 1 Config, 2 Theme, 3 Locale, 4 Editor, 5 Rust engine, 6 AI model, 7 Knowledge base (HNSW). Point at a lamp for details. Green means ready, orange means preparing, grey means switched off on purpose or not loaded, red means an error. Standby on the AI model and the knowledge base only means not loaded yet; it is not a fault. Click an orange, grey or red lamp to jump to where it is fixed (an error on 5 Rust engine opens the Help entry for when the Rust engine does not load).Yes
System settings gearsys:quick-settingsThe gear button that opens the system and log settings.Yes
Update indicatorsys:update-statusShows the update state: checking, update available (with the version), preparing. Click it when an update is available to confirm the download; the portable build opens the release page instead. It stays hidden while there is no update information.Yes
Save status indicatorsys:save-statusShows the result of the latest save. The autosave state and failures appear here and on the Save button's lamp.Yes

How it behaves

Log panel (sys:log-console)

WhenThen
Click the log row (button)Opens or closes the log panel
Drag the top borderChanges the panel height. Double-click resets it. The height is remembered (can be turned off in the settings)

Pipeline status LEDs (sys:pipeline-meter)

WhenThen
Lamp is greenThe stage is ready. Clicking does not move anywhere
Lamp is orange or grey (1 Config / 2 Theme / 3 Locale / 4 Editor / 6 AI model / 7 Knowledge base)Click to jump to the place that fixes it (1 System, 2 and 3 Header, 4 Editor, 6 and 7 the AI search tab)
Lamp 5 Rust engine is redClick to open the Help entry for when the Rust engine does not load. Typical causes are a version mismatch of the package (@1abcdefggs/vect-or-engine) or a missing file
When 6 AI model becomes readyWrites the log line once. It is not written for each downloaded file

System settings gear (sys:quick-settings)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the System tab of the settings page

Settings

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Confirm before closingAsk first when you close something with ×, so a stray click cannot close it. Tabs with unsaved changes are always asked about.Settings only
Reload Editor WindowRedraws the editor window only; the app keeps running. Use this when the screen looks wrong or after a UI change. Nothing is deleted.Settings only

System log

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Log panel at startupWhether the log panel is open when the app starts.LinkedLog panel: clear button

Setup.title: First-run setup
Setup.html:
The three steps at startup. There is no settings tab and no eye button.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Step 1: Language, appearance, themestp:step-appearanceStep 1 of the first-run setup. Choose the display language, the appearance (system, light or dark) and the theme. A choice applies at once.Not applicable (no eye button)
Languagestp:langThe display language (English or Japanese). The same value as the language on the settings page.Language (Linked)Not applicable (no eye button)
Appearancestp:modeThe appearance (system, light or dark). The same value as on the settings page.Not applicable (no eye button)
Themestp:themeChoose a theme. Each card shows a sample in the chosen appearance.Not applicable (no eye button)
Step 2: Save location, format, auto-savestp:step-savingStep 2 of the first-run setup. Choose the save folder and its name, the format of new documents (Markdown or text), and auto-save.Not applicable (no eye button)
Save locationstp:save-locationShows the save folder. Choose a folder to change it.Not applicable (no eye button)
Folder namestp:folder-nameThe name of the save folder. Press Enter or click outside the field to save it.Not applicable (no eye button)
File formatstp:formatChoose the format of new documents: Markdown (headings and tables as formatting) or plain text.Not applicable (no eye button)
Auto-savestp:autosaveTurns auto-save on while you write. Open the details to set the pause and new-line triggers.Not applicable (no eye button)
Auto-save delaystp:autosave-delayThe pause in seconds, in steps of 0.5, from 0.5 to 10.Not applicable (no eye button)
Step 3: Dictionary setupstp:step-dictionaryStep 3 of the first-run setup. Choose whether to turn on dictionary search (EMBED) and the cloud AI provider. Dictionary search runs on this PC. Text is sent to a cloud AI only when one is chosen.Not applicable (no eye button)
Cloud AI providerstp:cloud-providerChoose the cloud AI provider. If none is chosen, no cloud AI is used.Not applicable (no eye button)
Dictionary search (EMBED) on/off buttonstp:embedTurns on dictionary search (EMBED). When on, the model is prepared and matching dictionary items appear in the right panel. Without the model, no dictionary suggestions appear.Not applicable (no eye button)
Cancelstp:cancelQuits without saving the choices. Language, appearance, theme and the save folder go back to their values from when setup opened. Setup shows again at the next start.Not applicable (no eye button)
Backstp:backGoes back one step. Choices are kept.Not applicable (no eye button)
Next or Finishstp:nextGoes to the next step. On step 3 it reads Finish: stores the settings and closes.Not applicable (no eye button)

How it behaves

Step 1: Language, appearance, theme (stp:step-appearance)

WhenThen
When step 1 opensShows the current language, appearance and theme. A choice here applies at once

Dictionary search (EMBED) on/off button (stp:embed)

WhenThen
When the dictionary model is readyEMBED switches on by itself (unchanged)

Cancel (stp:cancel)

WhenThen
When Cancel is pressedPuts language, appearance, theme and the save folder (location and name) back to the values held when setup opened, then quits

Back (stp:back)

WhenThen
When Back is pressedMoves to the previous step. Choices stay

Next or Finish (stp:next)

WhenThen
When Next is pressed on step 1 or 2Moves to the next step. On step 2 the folder name is applied first; a problem keeps the user on the step
When Finish is pressed on step 3Stores the format, auto-save and dictionary choices, marks setup complete and closes
